summary: A firmware for small children: any key plays FM notes on a pentatonic scale over a backing beat, with four animal characters animating on screen. There are no menus and nothing to save.
features: Six-operator FM notes locked to a pentatonic scale
Synthesised drums and a backing beat toggled with PLAY
Monkey, Cat, Dog and Llama move with the music
Knobs for pet, speed, busy, bounce and squish
Built on ChoralRoot; first public beta, mostly checked on the emulator

headings: try it mac, no fm-1 needed
